frozen: 2026-10-10, BEFORE the claim-period code change. A changed expectation is a new decision and needs its own justification.

decisions.D1: Explicit period mismatches block both verified and contradicted: insufficient evidence, period mismatch. Today's verification behaviour is kept only when the claim has no usable period information.
decisions.D2: The SEC quarter-selection bug was not reproduced from the recorded payloads (the tie exists; list order saved it), so the full-year check ships here as a guard.
decisions.B1: FY2024 does not imply December 31. A fiscal year is matched only against the filer's own fiscal-year label for the observed period; a claimed date is matched only against the observed period end.
decisions.B2: Periods attach from the claim's own sentence only. A slide heading on another line ('Traction by Apr-16') never attaches.
decisions.B3: Historical reports keep their semantics version; the new rules apply to newly generated reports only.
